allocation_basis: H1 product revenue shares allocate TTM operating revenue as a research proxy, not observed TTM segment revenue.
rationale: Modest flagship volume absorption, continued series realization pressure and elevated production costs form alternative business hypotheses. No price uplift, instant margin recovery or new capacity monetization is assumed in Base.

research_case.thesis: 以五年产品经营路径研究贵州茅台的盈利与股东现金回报。低置信度Base假设：茅台酒销量每年增长1%、单位实现收入不增长；系列酒销量不增长、单位实现收入首年再降5%后有条件稳定；营业成本率维持10%。这些是可证伪研究判断，不是官方预测。经营利润继续接受母公司现金、项目与基金承诺、分配能力及终端条件的联合检验；本候选尚未成为正式合理价。
research_case.return_driver: 核心产品需求与实现收入的持续性、成本约束下的归母盈利，以及满足资本用途和母公司现金约束后的股东分配，是主要回报机制。显式期90%分配、首年部分上划延迟及次年释放均为条件假设。终端零增长与全额分配仍依赖盈利持续、必要再投资得到满足且现金能够合法分配。
research_case.mispricing_hypothesis: 待检验的预期差是：市场可能把系列酒及渠道调整压力过度外推，而核心产品在不涨价、成本率不恢复旧水平的条件下仍能维持有限增长和现金回报。相反，模型也可能低估实现收入持续下降、金融收益变化和母公司现金受限。尚未确认市场错误或股票低估，当前价格判断仍须独立通过有效估值与价格桥接准入。

positives.text: FY2025茅台酒收入同比增长0.39%、销量增长0.73%；核心产品未与系列酒同步出现收入下降，但不证明未来销量或单位实现收入增长。
H12026营业收入同比增长1.47%，营业成本增长21.81%；收入基础仍存在，盈利研究必须同时反映生产成本压力。
Base依赖核心产品有限增量被需求吸收、系列酒首年调整后不继续恶化；没有预支提价、立即反弹或历史成本率恢复。

counter_evidence.text: FY2025系列酒收入下降9.76%、销量增长3.88%；收入与销量背离，不支持认定产品组合压力已经结束。H1渠道变化也不能单独证明终端需求恢复。
H12026产品占比只用于分配TTM总收入的研究代理，实际TTM产品收入及未来组合未知；税率、归母归属和其他税前贡献保持参考口径也属于假设。
金融业务收益、客户资金与母公司可动用现金口径不同。FY2025与H12026母公司投资收益收现存在明显时点差异，合并盈利不等于当期可上划、可分配现金。
基金未缴承诺与项目资金用途须进入现金账；首年延迟次年释放和终端全额分配尚属条件。现金重放没有证明长期维护投入、上划限制或永久盈利。

thesis_breakers.text: 后续官方披露显示核心产品无法吸收Base销量增量，或单位实现收入持续走弱，应否决或下修Base，不用渠道切换掩盖需求变化。
系列酒首年调整后继续承压，或成本、营运资金及项目需求超出所选路径，应重算盈利与现金，撤销旧价格结果的适用性。
上划延迟未释放、母公司分配能力不足，或必要再投资使终端全额分配不可维持，相应现金或终端分支不成立。

next_events.text: 下一次官方经营披露后，核对产品、渠道收入、可取得的销量及实现收入代理、成本变化，逐项检验五年路径。
下一次财报与分配披露后，核对母公司现金、投资收益收现、金融业务贡献、基金实缴与项目支出，重放资金节点和分配约束。
新增资本开支、上划或资本配置证据出现时复审终端盈利和必要再投资；正式经济及事件审核完成前保持未批准研究身份。

bear.rationale: Flagship volume and realization weaken repeatedly; series realization continues to erode while the cost burden persists.

base.rationale: Flagship demand absorbs 1% annual volume without realization gains. Series realization falls another 5% once then stabilizes conditionally. Cost ratio remains 10%, with no return to older margins.

bull.rationale: Both products absorb modest volume growth with realization stable at the current reference level. No simultaneous price rebound and margin normalization.

inherited_cash_conditions: Existing parent cash, project budget, fund commitments, reserve and distribution assumptions are retained and fully recomputed.
10% first-year remittance delay releases in year two; persistent restriction is not valued by this branch.
No incremental operating-asset return is added. The inherited cash yield applies only to changes in modeled parent cash.
Tax, parent attribution, nonrecurring amount and other pre-tax contributions stay at TTM reference assumptions.
Zero terminal growth and full payout still assume permanent continuation of terminal profit and lawful distribution.
counter_evidence: H1 revenue increased 1.47% but cost increased 21.81%; volume growth does not guarantee profit growth.
Channel migration and dynamic prices do not establish final demand recovery or sustainable realization.
Current H1 product mix may differ from actual TTM and future mix; rounded observations do not identify forecast parameters.
Financial subsidiary income and parent remittance are different scopes; a fixed residual contribution and cash-yield response may fail.
thesis_breakers: Flagship volume absorption fails or realization deteriorates beyond the selected path.
Series realization fails to stabilize after the assumed first-year reset.
Production costs exceed the selected ratio or working capital and project needs exceed the inherited budget.
Delayed remittance is not released, distribution capacity fails, or perpetual terminal profitability cannot be supported.
unknowns: Actual TTM product revenue and forward product/channel volume-realization decomposition.
Maintenance versus expansion capex, future parent remittance restrictions and all payment-date cash needs.
Future tax, financial subsidiary contribution, parent attribution and terminal competitive advantage duration.
